text: The purpose of this report is to appoint directors to the Cabbagetown, College West, Greektown on the Danforth, and Junction Gardens BIA boards of management and remove directors from Church-Wellesley Village, Greektown on the Danforth, Kensington Market, Liberty Village, Ossington Avenue, Queen Street West, Regal Heights Village, and Roncesvalles Village BIA boards of management.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. In accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, appointed the following nominees to the Business Improvement Area (BIA) boards of management set out below at the pleasure of Toronto and East York Community Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon thereafter as successors are appointed: Cabbagetown: Michaud, Gerald College West: Bordokas, Alexander Greektown on the Danforth: Vassos, Helene Junction Gardens: Di Bernardo, Janet Yurchuk, Dan 2. Remove the following directors from the Business Improvement Area (BIA) boards of management set out below: Church-Wellesley Village: Ihasz, Claire Greektown on the Danforth: Leventis, Savas Papalambropoulos, Nick Velonis, Angelo Kensington Market: Hod, Avital Liberty Village: Kojokin, Stanislav Ossington Avenue: Drabik, Stephanie Queen Street West:…
